1981-2415-5468-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5468-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent loses 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

3755-4687-5296.notablePrerequisites: Workhorse has at least four counters on it.
3755-4687-5296.description:
Activate Elven Chorus by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Workhorse, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

4247-6553-7424.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3129-4772-4826-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

907-2921-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

1849-3259-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
1849-3259-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Mass Hysteria can be omitted.

1621-1739-1895-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

670-1619-2292-3175-4681.easyPrerequisites: Sefris' first ability hasn't triggered this turn.
670-1619-2292-3175-4681.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in the second to last room of any dungeon.
670-1619-2292-3175-4681.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Sefris' first ability triggers, causing you to venture into the final room of a dungeon, causing you to complete the dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Sefris and Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sefris trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into the Cave Entrace room, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into either available room.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Sefris from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sefris enters, Radiant Solar triggers, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into any available room.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.
670-1619-2292-3175-4681.notes: You may instead execute this combo by venturing into Tomb of Annihilation instead of Lost Mine of Phandelver.

An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
1115-3259-7686.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-3968-5434.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3968-5434.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2292-7430--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Gorma trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat
2292-7430--5.notes: Each loop, Gorma will place an additional +1/+1 counter on the persist creature compared to the previous loop. This'll eventually result in both the persist creature and Gorma having infinite +1/+1 counters on them.

2577-5231-7390.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, The Ghoul triggers, causing you to get two rad counters and create a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

206-339-413-677.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

3259-4068-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
3259-4068-7358.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

851-2457-4289-7296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1687-5686-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1687-5686-5972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

413-560-4550-7256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
413-560-4550-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Zombie and Soldier enter, Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Warhost's Frenzy triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 4 with the other Blasting Station trigger, sacrificing the Soldier instead.
Repeat from step 2.

539-3967-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

132-1978-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
132-1978-7013.description:
Activate Myr Welder using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
If Voltaic Construct is on the battlefield, activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder. Otherwise, activate Myr Welder using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

3771-4050-4484-5643.manaNeeded: {B}{B} plus up to an additional {3} if Animar has fewer than two +1/+1 counters on it
3771-4050-4484-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3771-4050-4484-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}, reduced by {1} for each +1/+1 counter on Animar.
Geralf's first ability and Animar trigger.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Geralf trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3771-4050-4484-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

4050-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4050-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath, adding {2}
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4050-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

841-2511-4544--106.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-2511-4544--106.description:
Play a land card.
Dúnedain Rangers and the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger.
Resolve the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the creature token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
841-2511-4544--106.notes: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

790-1218-5076.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
790-1218-5076.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Kederekt Parasite infect until end of turn.
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-3719-4284-5326.notablePrerequisites: Clone has a power of at least 2.
1912-3719-4284-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Clone and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Clone from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Clone to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Clone enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Clone by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2104-4823-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation and Timeless Witness each turn.
2104-4823-6122.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Timeless Witness by paying its mana cost.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Timeless Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1479-3257-5702.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3257-5702.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Springheart Nantuko, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1987-2493-3617-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2493-3617-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

1636-3888-4161-4694.notablePrerequisites:
Olivia's Attendants does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Olivia's Attendants indestructible.
1636-3888-4161-4694.description:
Cast Brawl by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Give Olivia's Attendants indestructible, if needed.
Activate Olivia's Attendants by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
Olivia's Attendants triggers, creating that many Blood artifact tokens.
The Bloods enter the battlefield as 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Intruder Alarm triggers that many times, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3.

3310-3693-4613.notablePrerequisites: War Elemental has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3310-3693-4613.description:
Activate War Elemental using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
War Elemental triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.

31-1068-5161.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
When Leveler enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library.
Activate Hapless Researcher by sacrificing it, causing you to return Hapless Researcher from your graveyard to the battlefield due to Out of the Tombs and discard a card.
Repeat step 3.

215-3003-3676-4050-5176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eleven artifacts.
215-3003-3676-4050-5176.description:
Cast Mycosynth Golem by paying {0}.
Radagast and Tangleroot trigger.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Radagast trigger, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Beast, adding {1}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Mycosynth Golem from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-1079-2882-4221.manaNeeded: {5}{G}, plus enough mana to cast the creature with flash
147-1079-2882-4221.notablePrerequisites:
An additional creature card with flash in hand.
Infinite Reflection attached to Dualcaster Mage.
(Note: Casting Infinite Reflection before Living Plane is recommended.
This combo has a chance of failure depending on the density of lands and creatures in your deck).
147-1079-2882-4221.description:
Cast Green Sun's Twilight with X equal to 5 or more by paying at least {5}{G}.
In response, cast a creature spell with flash by paying its mana cost.
The creature enters the battlefield as a copy of Dualcaster Mage, triggering its ETB effect, copying Green Sun's Twilight.
Resolve that copy, revealing at least the top six cards of your library and putting a creature and/or land card from among them onto the battlefield, then putting the rest on the bottom.
Each creature or land chosen this way enters the battlefield as a copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

1956-4447.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Ronom Serpent.
A player controls no snow lands.
1956-4447.description:
If needed, give control of Ronom Serpent to an opponent who controls no snow lands.
When Ronom Serpent's controller controls no snow lands, Ronom Serpent triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Ronom Serpent cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Ronom Serpent triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

1938-4200-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Glorious Protector and exiling Ephemerate.
Glorious Protector leaves and enters the battlefield, returning Icewind Stalwart from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Icewind Stalwart and Glorious Protector's enters-the-battlefield abilities.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Icewind Stalwart until Glorious Protector enters the battlefield.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart trigger, blinking Glorious Protector.
Repeat from step 2.
